comment: There are four LIM switches but only three CHK switches, each choking the slot to its right, so the last slot has no choke. The first speed attenuverter is named 'Speed CV Attenuv. #1' in the source while the other three are named 'Speed CV #n' (DrumPlayerPlus.cpp:158-161), so the tooltip on the first one is worded differently from its neighbours. The slot displays are custom widgets with no ParamWidget, so their own right-click menus cannot be reached by clicking them for help.
